edits:
- name: Validate critical production artifact on the actual newly calculated forecast
        id: archived-weather-validation
        continue-on-error: true
        if: inputs.restart_archived_weather == true && steps.archived-weather-build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          DMI_BULK_CACHE_PATH: .cache/dmi-candidate-progress.json
        run: >-
          node scripts/run-validation-collection.mjs
          --script validate:production-artifact
          --output .geometry-v2-work/production-artifact-validation-report.json

      - name: Run production release gate on the actual newly calculated forecast
        id: archived-weather-release-gate
        continue-on-error: true
        if: always() && inputs.restart_archived_weather == true && steps.archived-weather-build.outcome == 'success'
        run: npm run release:gate:production

      - name: Upload payload-free archived production validation reports
        continue-on-error: true
        if: always() && inputs.restart_archived_weather == true && hashFiles('.geometry-v2-work/production-artifact-validation-report.json', '.geometry-v2-work/production-release-validation-report.json') != ''
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ravradar-production-validation-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            .geometry-v2-work/production-artifact-validation-report.json
            .geometry-v2-work/production-release-validation-report.json
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Require both archived production collections before any new production writes
        id: archived-production-gates
        if: always() && inputs.restart_archived_weather == true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${{ steps.archived-weather-build.outcome }}" = success
          test "${{ steps.archived-weather-validation.outcome }}" = success
          test "${{ steps.archived-weather-release-gate.outcome }}" = success

      - name: Run full validation on the actual newly calculated forecast
        id: archived-weather-validation
        if: inputs.restart_archived_weather == true
        run: npm run validate

      - name: Run full release gate on the actual newly calculated forecast
        id: archived-weather-release-gate
        if: inputs.restart_archived_weather == true
        run: npm run release:gate

    # The provider-free archive rebuild measured about 43 minutes before its
    # artifact checks. Reserve bounded time for those checks and late B/S/Edges.
    # Ordinary code-only repair keeps its existing 60-minute limit.
    timeout-minutes: ${{ inputs.restart_archived_weather == true && 90 || 60 }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
